## Work log

<!-- Chronological, written as you go. What was actually done, why, what it cost.
     Reference commits and link to plans and notes. Prose beats a checklist here —
     this is the part you will actually reread in three months. -->

- **Symposium schedule.** Populated the Riverbanks Symposium sheet from the 6 Oct "Seapunk Symposium" Granola call: three parts (Seapunk and the Riverbanks process with the Ecoarchy canvas; themes and the fishbowl; what's next as a soft close), formatted, with start/end times and Part durations as formulas. Re-timed twice as the slot moved from 1–5 pm to 9–12 and then 9–12:30. Not in the repo; the sheet is in Drive.
- **Act Three script, v1** ([plan](../plans/2026-10-07_act-three-script.plan.md)). Recapped the two competing versions (KAE Draft v1 and the 6 Oct talk), then wrote the act page by page with Yan: six pages, from Daria's typhoon dream in Manila to Faris dismantling the Myitsone Dam. Yan supplied the outline for pages 3–6. Saved as `content/drafts/2026-10-07_act-three_v1.md` and in RIVERBOOK's new *Script: Kinetic Adaptation Economy* tab; the canon file records it. `script-to-doc.py` cannot write into a brand-new tab whose only paragraph is its title (the insert index equals the segment end), so an empty body paragraph was added first.

- **Act Three boards** ([plan](../plans/2026-10-07_act-three-boards.plan.md)). 17 new cast sheets checked and starred, including Siratana and Patika from Smita's Riverkeepers material at Yan's suggestion; comic `739cacfd…` created with its six grids and insets. Blocked at page 1 when the Gemini credits ran out; after Yan topped up, all six pages were generated, lettered and checked by eye. Daria's sheet now follows the printed Prologue (black hair). The donut diagrams on pages 2–3 are SVG.

- **Donut diagrams as props.** The generated donut slides didn't read, and hand-drawn SVGs didn't look right, so the diagrams became cast props. Baselines were rebuilt by code on Kate Raworth's actual Doughnut (social foundation, ecological ceiling, 12 + 9 wedges), reviewed in an artifact, then redrawn with Nano Banana Pro (same Gemini key) as isometric little worlds in the comic's style, using two Act Three panels as style references. Takes were compared on a Design canvas artifact. The propeller follows the moodboard's donut_tree.png. Four props now exist: the floor donut, the breathing donut, the donut tree, the Myitsone donut. Images in riverbanks/donut-props/ (untracked, like the moodboard); SVG baselines and generator scripts in scripts/donut-props/.
